text: Review docs/design/decision-sets.md together with the revised docs/design/defaults-loop.md (its introspection step), written to docs/design/reviews/decision-sets-review-1.md. They must fit as one system: introspection records, the defaults loop, typed decisions in sets, and failure signals that put a decision under review. Check claims against the code and records, check the Jev usage against POST /v1/evaluate as the defaults-loop design now describes it, and say which smallest first build would prove the system on real records. End with a verdict: accept, accept with changes listed, or reject. Review only.
